verdict.rationale: The New York Department of State is a government filing and records service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, and the filing host reset the connection when an agent tried to reach it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
